title: meshIRCd as a MIMI gateway (server-side provider)
description: Mark 2026-11-21: bead only for now. meshIRCd (Go, federated, S2S JSON-LD over mTLS) could speak MIMI protocol-07 as a provider, its users appearing in MIMI rooms; E2EE ends at the gateway. Depends on the multi-user host design (mimid-kiy1 puppet mode) and on whether meshIRCd continues. Revisit after the IRC bridge (relay mode).
notes:
Open question, raised 2026-11-22 and deliberately deferred by Mark (not on the critical path): this bead needs mimid to be an IRC CLIENT, connecting outward to someone else's IRC server. Everything built so far is the opposite: mimid-agent-irc is an IRC server for a local client.

The only IRC client code in the tree is crates/mimid-agent/tests/common/irc.rs (388 lines), written as an INDEPENDENT test oracle: it parses lines with its own parser, not the front end's, which is what makes the front-end tests prove anything. Promoting it to production would destroy that property.

Readings to pick from when this becomes ready: (a) meshIRCd owns the IRC side and speaks MIMI to mimid, no IRC client here at all; (b) a production IRC client in its own crate, leaving the test oracle untouched (AGENTS.md forbids an IRC library); (c) promote the test client and find the front-end tests a new oracle. Decide before any code, as a decision bead.
